title: Scales of Justice
description:
Name: [Geburah](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/geburah.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Briah Dimension, entered through Eye of Geburah.
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: Judges both Accused and itself for sins. Summons flocks of Judgement Birds and an array of lasers and projectiles. Unable to be damaged naturally and must be made to sin, shown on the screens at its base.
